text:
Marissa Cole: @here release coord for guided onboarding checklist beta. Want to lock: flag defaults, monitoring/alerts, and rollback owners for next train.

Dylan Brooks: +1. current flag is `console_guided_onboarding_checklist` (FE) + `checklist_state_api` (BE). proposal:
- default OFF globally
- targeting ON for allowlist + 5% of *new orgs* only
- admin override for support/debug stays internal only

Chloe Martin: on BE side we can keep `checklist_state_api` enabled but gated by the FE flag (no UI = no calls). safer to keep the API available for allowlisted orgs only though. if we flip FE by mistake, API endpoints shouldn’t suddenly start writing for everyone.

Nadia Rahman: +1 on gating writes. telemetry is the bigger risk for beta since we’re watching funnel. if flag leaks to more orgs, events volume spikes + dashboards get noisy.

Logan Wright: for monitoring, we need 2 things:
1) telemetry health (events arriving + schema validation pass rate)
2) funnel (step completion + dropoff)
I can set alerting thresholds but need owners + what’s “rollback-worthy”.

Leila Farouk: QA note: we saw a couple flaky E2Es when validation lag is >2m (first request completion). for beta, we should expect up to ~5m. Can we note that in go/no-go + reduce alert sensitivity so we don’t panic on normal lag?

Amara Diallo: gateway metrics lag is ~60-90s in steady state, but can be 3-4m during deploys. also one edge case: 429 storms during onboarding can create “first success” never happens. might want a guardrail alert on 429 ratio for beta cohort.

Marissa Cole: ok, let’s define “beta rollback triggers”:
- telemetry pipeline: onboarding events missing >15m in any region OR schema reject rate >1%
- checklist UI error rate >2% for beta cohort
- unexpected cohort growth (flag targeting bug)
Sound right?

Dylan Brooks: yes. also add: backend write errors >1% on checklist state endpoint (5xx). if we see that, step state won’t persist and UX is confusing.

Logan Wright: I’ll wire alerts:
- `onboarding_event_ingest_lag_p95 > 15m` (per region)
- `onboarding_event_schema_reject_rate > 1%`
- `console.checklist_ui_render_error_rate > 2%` (needs FE metric name confirmation)
- `checklist_state_api_5xx_rate > 1%`
and a “flag exposure” monitor (count of orgs with flag true day-over-day).

Nadia Rahman: FE emits `onboarding.checklist.step_viewed` etc. We also have BE emit `onboarding.checklist.step_completed` when validator flips a step. We should make sure we *don’t* page on low event volume overnight. maybe alert only during business hours + use anomaly detection?

Ethan Park: +1. keep pages to “hard failures”. funnel movement is for daily review.

Marissa Cole: owners for rollback:
- Flag flip (disable cohort): Dylan
- Telemetry pipeline / schema regressions: Nadia + Logan
- Product decision to pause beta / expand cohort: Marissa
- QA go/no-go / known issues call: Leila
Does anyone object?

Dylan Brooks: works. I’ll also own updating the runbook with exact steps. right now it’s scattered across the PR description + notes.

Chloe Martin: rollback steps should include:
1) flip FE flag OFF (stops traffic)
2) keep BE endpoints up but block writes for non-allowlisted orgs
3) if validator job is causing load, disable validator worker queue
I can document the BE toggles.

Leila Farouk: can we also add a quick “smoke check” list for after we flip ON for the cohort?
- create new org, see checklist
- create API key, step updates
- make first request, step updates within ~5m
- visit usage dashboard, step updates
I can add to release checklist.

DeployBot: ReleaseTrain: build `console-web@9.42.0` staged to canary. Change summary: "guided onboarding checklist behind flag". Tracking: ENG-23110, ENG-23112.

Amara Diallo: on 429 ratio alert: I’ll add a query for beta cohort only (by org_id allowlist). If it’s >10% of requests for >10m, that’s a signal docs/UX is pushing folks into retry loops.

Logan Wright: ok. I’ll set the 429 alert as non-paging (slack notification to #eng-releases + #support) so we can react without waking people.

Marissa Cole: final call: flag defaults = OFF, allowlist + 5% new orgs. start cohort Monday after train goes out.
Please drop links here when ready:
- runbook
- dashboards
- alert list

Dylan Brooks: runbook draft will be in confluence later today. will include:
`Flags -> console_guided_onboarding_checklist -> targeting rules` + rollback steps + escalation path.

Nadia Rahman: I’ll post telemetry dashboard links once Mei finishes the Looker tile wiring. For now Datadog board is ready.

Marissa Cole: :thumbsup: thanks. I’ll update the release note draft to say “beta, limited cohort, may take a few minutes for steps to validate.”
